summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of GA4 activation (G-2P77N0M1KX) and Experience Our Work real project links. All targeted features verified live in the preview URL. No regressions detected.

ga4.cta_click_pushes_events: dataLayer grew from 11 -> 14 after CTA interaction (cta_click emitted)

regression.funnel_goal_step: 6 goal-* options visible; clicking advances to Deliverable step visually (screenshot confirmed 360° Virtual Tour, Digital Twin, 3D/CGI, Interactive Website options)

ExperienceWork.jsx correctly conditions target=_blank + rel=noopener noreferrer on url presence — good.
Consider adding a data-testid on the Deliverable step buttons (e.g. deliverable-<key>) to make future automated testing more reliable; today they are only discoverable via role/text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GA4 live with G-2P77N0M1KX; Experience cards link to real tours in new tab. All previous iteration_3 flows still pass. Note deliverable step buttons currently lack data-testid='deliverable-*' — if that becomes a testing requirement, ask main agent to add them.
